segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hey Dana, thanks for taking the call. Sorry I didn’t get you yesterday afternoon, the renewal quote was stuck until I fixed the duplicate billing account in the CRM. I’ve got the 48-seat version in front of me now.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No problem. Yeah, we’re trying to lock this by August 16 so finance can put it on the September invoice run.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Makes sense. For 48 seats on the team plan, annual comes to $38,400, and implementation is $4,200 one-time. If you add the five contractors later, those would just prorate at the same seat rate.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. We may actually start with 42 employees and hold the contractors until October. Does that change the go-live date?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Not really. If we have the order form back by next Friday, go-live can still be September 9. Training would be two admin sessions and one end-user session that week.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Can you do a security review call Tuesday morning? Our IT lead has a window at 10.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Tuesday at 10 is tough, I’ve got a batch of deal desk packets due after month-end cleanup. I can do Tuesday at 2 or Wednesday at 10, and I’ll bring our solutions lead.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Wednesday at 10 works. On terms, legal asked for net 45 instead of net 30. Is that going to be a problem?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: For a one-year term, net 45 usually needs approval, but it’s not unusual. I’ll add that to the redline summary and keep the discount at 12%.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Also, the invoice needs to show the Denver office address, not corporate in Chicago.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, I’ll make sure that’s on the order form. If the PDF lands a little late today, it’s just because the billing tool wants the ship-to and bill-to fields to match before it’ll generate cleanly.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Understood. Send it over when you can, and I’ll route it to finance and legal.
